I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
If you’re watching your budget, here are your most wallet-friendly options with us:
Keep order size tight: Our minimum is 30 units per size/color, so stick close to that if you can.
Save on shipping: For UK, EU and Switzerland, delivery is included in the unit cost, so no surprise shipping fees.
Spread the cost: On orders over £60, you can use Klarna Pay in 3 or Pay in 30 days (subject to status, 18+ UK residents).
Choose smaller commitments over extras: Pre-production branded samples are £60/€60 each, so only add these if you really need to see one first.
Flexible payment methods: You can pay with major cards, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and some local options like Bancontact and iDeal, so you can use whatever works best for your budgeting.
Gifting on a budget: Our gift cards start at £10, and you can combine amounts instead of buying a large single card.
